description: This file defines the RowRenderer class responsible for rendering table rows into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering library. It handles various aspects like row height, padding, cell rendering, and row grouping.

classes.name: RowRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a Row object to RTF format in the MigraDoc library. It manages row styling, cell rendering, and row-specific controls.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render a Row to RTF, including borders, padding, height, and cells.

methods.name: RenderTopBottomPadding
methods.description: Handles rendering of top and bottom padding controls for the row.

methods.name: RenderRowHeight
methods.description: Determines and renders the row height based on the specified height and height rule.
